messages:
eve: spotted duplicated token charges in invoice-preview after we flipped the per-route aggregator change during the 01:40 batch. small # of tenants but visible.
dan: example?
eve: pulled this pair from raw topic:
[01:41:12Z] event_id=ev_aaa request_id=req_901 route=cpu-v2 tokens=300
[01:41:12Z] event_id=ev_bbb request_id=req_901 route=cpu-v2-fallback tokens=300
hyun: hmm, aggregator now groups by (tenant, route_key, request_id) which will double count forks.
dan: can we collapse on request_id for the short term? any false positives?
hyun: some SDKs intentionally fan-out a logical request into multiple backend requests with distinct prompts; collapsing purely on request_id will undercount those.
eve: edge does set parent_request_id for forks but we don't persist it in billing_events.
hyun: short-term mitigation: consumer dedupe for events with same request_id AND same model_alias AND same created_at (second precision) during the batch window. ops can run a backfill for the last 6 hours.
dan: make a ticket and add a console alert for duplicate-rate > 0.2% in batch windows.
metering-bot: ACTION CREATED: tickets/ENGPLAT-1955 by hyun - "batch-duplication-hotfix-and-provenance".
eve: assigning hyun to hotfix, dan to backfill script, i'll draft CS note. closing when ENGPLAT-1955 has PRs linked. :thumbsup:
